intent: name a new font family after a figure or a thing that the story asks for: a name drawn at random from a list of the tool, chosen with reasons, and valid as a family name

in.name: story
in.text: what the family is for, and what it should be named after

out.text: the chosen name, its reason, and the folder of placeholder font files

rules.label: Folder of the name lists, one JSON file for each list
Names that code draws at random from the list
rules.note: at least the three candidates of pick (with 2, every run is held back at picks-ok); eight gives the model a choice and keeps the prompt short. The smallest list has 13 names

rules.label: Seed of the draw; 0 makes a new draw for each run
rules.note: a fixed seed makes a run repeatable: the regression set uses one

rules.label: Longest family name, in characters
rules.note: name ID 1 has at most 31 characters; 28 leaves room for a short word such as Text

rules.label: Folder for the new families, relative to the tool folder

flow.name: Read the lists
flow.do: read the name lists: the name of each list, what it holds, and how many names it has

flow.name: Choose a list
flow.do: read the story and pick the one list whose names the story asks for. Give its name exactly as in lists, or none when no list fits

flow.name: An answer the tool knows
flow.check: the answer names one of the lists, or none

fail.when: the model named no list of the tool

flow.name: A list fits the story
flow.check: the answer is a list, not none

fail.when: no list of the tool fits the story

flow.name: Draw names
flow.do: draw names at random from the list, each with its note

flow.name: Choose names
flow.intent: choose the names that fit the story best, as a type designer names a family

intent_spec.text: choose the names that fit the story best, as a type designer names a family
intent_spec.style: one sentence of reason for each name: the story, and how the name looks in letters

flow.do: from the drawn names, choose the three that fit the story best, best first. Give each name exactly as drawn, and one sentence why it fits

flow.name: Names from the draw
flow.check: each pick is a drawn name, and no name comes twice

fail.when: the model chose names that were not drawn

flow.name: Family names
flow.do: make each pick a family name: Latin letters and digits, no spaces; list the families that exist in files.out

flow.name: Valid family names
flow.check: each family name has only ASCII letters and digits, starts with a letter, has at most {family.max_name} characters, and no two are the same

fail.when: a name is not a valid family name

flow.name: The names fit the story
flow.check: pass when each name fits what the story asks for; fail when a name ignores it

fail.when: the names do not fit the story

flow.name: Which name for the family?
flow.check: show the person the three names with their reasons. A name can be the name of a font that exists, or a trademark: the tool cannot check that

flow.name: The family folder is new
flow.check: no folder of the chosen family is in files.out yet

fail.when: the folder of that family exists

flow.name: Write the placeholders
flow.do: make the folder of the family in files.out, with one empty file for each style and format: Family-Style.otf

flow.name: Every placeholder is there
flow.check: every placeholder file is in the new folder, and nothing else

flow.name: The result
flow.do: give the chosen name, its reason, the seed of the draw, and the folder of the placeholders

notes.text: the run shows the value of the step before its end; without this step the run ends after a gate and gives no result

flow.name: Named: run font-names on the new folder
The person chose none: nothing written

intent_spec.text: name a new font family after a figure or a thing that the story asks for: a name drawn at random from a list of the tool, chosen with reasons, and valid as a family name
intent_spec.audience: type designers who name a new family
intent_spec.style: three names, one sentence of reason for each, no invented names

never.text: propose a name that is not in a list of the tool
write files without the choice of a person
write into a folder that exists
